column1: # clues.tsv for ft_strlen — hints only, never answers.
Where does a C string end? You have to walk it one byte at a time until you reach that marker. Two questions: what marks the end, and does that marker itself count toward the length?
Spaces, tabs and digits are ordinary bytes — they are part of the string. If a length looks too small, are you stopping early on a byte you think is "not a real character"?
